title: Pentateuch with Rashi's commentary by M. Rosenbaum and A.M. Silbermann, 1929-1934
text: ויעש בצלאל AND BEZALEL MADE [THE ARK] — Because he gave himself over to the work more whole-heartedly than the other wise men it is called after his name (his name alone is associated with the act) (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 10).
